# Synthetic Issue pickup trial

Implement a tiny sum utility, then document the accepted implementation.
Manager owns planning and acceptance. One local worker at a time; each
attempt gets reports/<task>/<attempt>.md and observations/<task>/<attempt>/.
Use Python standard library only; at most 3 verification runs per attempt.
No network, installs, nested agents, push, merge, or source commits by workers.
Creating a local clone and worktree from the supplied source is authorized.

# Sum utility

## T01
Implement total(values) in src/calc.py.
Accept an iterable of numbers, return its sum (0 for empty input), and
leave caller-owned input unchanged. Verify with
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_calc.py -v.
Allowed writes: src/calc.py, reports/T01/, observations/T01/.

## T02
After Manager accepts T01 and supplies its exact retained delivery
and passing check, write docs/usage.md with a runnable example and empty
input behavior. Verify the example against that accepted implementation.
Allowed writes: docs/usage.md, reports/T02/, observations/T02/.
T01 has no accepted delivery yet. Do not substitute the initial stub.

Keep tests, planning files, and the other task's scope read-only. Return
actual commands, exit codes, artifacts and fingerprints to Manager.
